title: Miner dry-run + live-capture + master production readiness

simple_definitions.dry_run: Software check only: for each panic invocation with a curated calm tail, rebuild the calm completion, check prefix/d coherence, run validate_pair. Does not load the LLM for activations and does not write pairs/natural.
simple_definitions.live_capture: Same checks, then run the model on the shared prompt prefix and capture hidden-state activations at divergence for calm vs panic completions. Writes activations_at_d.pt + admission_gate under pairs/natural/<slug>/.
simple_definitions.production_ready: Master dashboard green light for shipping CAST steering vectors. Requires tooling green + at least 3 on-disk pool-eligible natural pairs + neutral/identity/aggregate gates green. Dry-run alone can never make this true.

bugs_fixed: Master/extract only scanned legacy UNI_CAA01 — now discovers UNI_CAA01_corpus + legacy
Dry-run gate was vacuous (always pass) — now requires validated>=1 and zero hard validate failures
validate_pair rejects dropped root-cause detail — now serialize failed check ids
d_extract vs tracer misalignment / bad_tail_text char-sliced by token index — normalized on extract d + tokenizer decode
Metrics conflated dry-run validates with on-disk admits — environment notes now distinguish

live_capture_review.verdict: PATH PROVEN (CPU); XPU currently unstable after OOM/DEVICE_LOST
live_capture_review.xpu_status: Small XPU allocs work; full 7B .to(xpu) hits DEVICE_LOST/OOM after earlier crash cycles. Reboot/reset Intel GPU recommended before full XPU mining batch.

why_production_false: caa_neutral_purity_gate.json pass=false (N5 delta slightly over 0.15 at L10)
need >=3 on-disk natural pairs (have 2: 1 corpus + 1 legacy)
tau/sigma + CAST injection deferred by design
master_production.what_this_means: You are ready to mine. You are not ready to claim production CAST vectors.

next_steps: Reset XPU (reboot or GPU driver reset), then CAA_MINE_LIVE=1 mine --unicaa01-corpus --live --device xpu for the remaining ~38
Or continue CPU mining if XPU stays broken (slow but correct)
After >=3 pool-eligible pairs: re-check/fix neutral N5 and provenance PR4, then re-run caa_master_gate.py
Only then extract steering vectors / consider production_ready
